latest.title: Five scene findings flag kids needing blood
latest.finding: Altered GCS, penetrating mechanism and age-adjusted hypotension led; a three-tier tree captured 36.8% of early transfusions in 3.3% of children.

latest.title: Fall-alarm calls without lights and sirens
latest.finding: Lights-and-siren response fell from 98% to 12% of calls; 0.2% later needed an upgrade.

latest.title: Mobile ECPR team cannulates on scene
latest.finding: Pilot protocol aiming to cut collapse-to-flow by at least 15 minutes.
